study_scope: S-only causal persistence-residual forecasting; no external covariates or historical financial release inputs

context_baselines.seasonal_naive: available only when the configured period P is no longer than the causal input history
context_baselines.dlinear: learned contextual baseline with the same input length, maximum horizon, seed set, optimizer, early stopping, and training samples as M1-M3

statistical_selection.selection_metric: mean path RMSE on at most 20 fixed non-overlapping validation origins per series
statistical_selection.fit_failure_fallback: persistence for that origin, with failure retained in failures.csv
statistical_selection.warning_policy: ConvergenceWarning and RuntimeWarning emitted during candidate fit are treated as failed fits and written to failures.csv

state_features.change_score: max(abs(latest_level_z), abs(first_difference_z), abs(second_difference_z), abs(short_trend_z), volatility_ratio, max_abs_jump_z, abs(seasonal_deviation_z))
state_features.missing_rule: never use a future value; windows with unresolved values are ineligible

evaluation.multiple_testing: predeclared Holm families: primary H1/H2, stable safety, external holdout, and robustness

failure_policy.missing_primary_unit: retain unit and automatically expand the frozen candidate pool before downgrading the estimand

amendment.reason: V1 completed synthetic and real matrices, but the fixed ETS/ARIMA candidates emitted numerical and convergence warnings that were not represented in failures.csv even though the plan requires statistical non-convergence to be recorded. V1 synthetic and real artifacts remain retained development evidence and are not pooled with V2.
amendment.correction: V2 reruns the complete synthetic and real matrices from the same verified raw sources and frozen model specification. Statistical ConvergenceWarning and RuntimeWarning are now explicit failed fits, recorded in failures.csv, with the prespecified persistence fallback.
